note: Literature establishes that TRA2B-associated Ramond-Elliott syndrome frequently features microcephaly alongside short stature and feeding difficulties.

evidence.text: In a study of 12 individuals with TRA2B variants, neurodevelopmental delay was frequently accompanied by microcephaly, brain anomalies, feeding difficulties, and short stature.

source.title: Clustered variants in the 5′ coding region of TRA2B ...
source.quote: All affected individuals presented intellectual disability and/or developmental delay, frequently associated with infantile spasms, microcephaly, brain anomalies, autism spectrum disorder, feeding difficulties, and short stature.

evidence.text: OMIM entry 621421 notes that affected individuals exhibit mildly impaired growth, small head circumference, and feeding difficulties.

source.title: 621421 - RAMOND-ELLIOTT NEURODEVELOPMENTAL ...
source.quote: Some had mildly impaired growth, small head circumference, feeding difficulties, or constipation.
